name: ANGENT Figma
description: Domain diagram models, editable Figma construction, prototype and design system reviews through available runtime tools

source.origin: Independent ANGENT implementation informed by public Reqwise features (https://ai4ba.com/figma-mcp) and MIT OSS reference
source.license: ANGENT repository license; no commercial Reqwise Pro code included

runtime.native: available Figma MCP or Figma plugin capability

capabilities.when: Define editable actors, use cases and system boundary
Model navigable interaction across screens and errors
Diagram business activities with responsible owners
Model synchronous and asynchronous cross-component messages
Define business object state transitions and guards
Visualize entities, keys and foreign-key relationships
Show end-to-end user experience and friction
Show information architecture and navigational hierarchy
Synthesize research-backed behavior patterns without stereotypes
Create editable reusable Figma foundations from approved art direction
Construct a stakeholder walkthrough using editable Figma prototype
